events.text: San Miguel Global Power Holdings Corp. has a Sustainability Committee Charter dated 3 August 2023 that sets out the Committee's role, authority, duties, responsibilities and procedures.

MUFG Bank's Manila branch completed its first sustainable trade asset finance transactions with San Miguel Global Power and SN Aboitiz Power Magat Inc., supporting more than 1 gigawatt of renewable energy capacity under the Green Energy Auction programme.
San Miguel Global Power Holdings Corp. deployed ₱4.5 billion from its latest bond proceeds to accelerate the rollout of renewable energy projects.
A priest slammed San Miguel's 'silence' on an oil spill, saying the company cannot be trusted with safety as long as it remains chained to the fossil fuel industry.
San Miguel Aerocity Inc.-owned Navotas landfill fire continued for a week since April 10, raising air pollution and health concerns in Metro Manila.
In the first quarter of 2022, San Miguel Corporation began preparatory work for a coal mine in the village.
The Energy Regulatory Commission approved P31.34B cost recoveries for power firms, including P29.2B for San Miguel Global Power.
